The '''Cloud City Pod Car''', also known as the '''Bespin Motors Cloud Car''', '''Prototype Cloud Car''', or sometimes as a '''single-pod cloud car''', was an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] prototype vehicle known as a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]], popularized by its use in the habitable zone of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], home of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The Pod Car, manufactured by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]], saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a patrol craft for the [[Cloud City Sky Patrol]]. In attack mode, the Pod Car featured a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher. Combat equipped versions included mounted, dual [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on their underbellies.

==Characteristics==
[[File:CloudCityPodCar.png|thumb|left|200px|A Cloud City Pod Car in attack mode]]
The [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] Pod Car was an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] prototype [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]]. The vehicle was also known as the [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] Cloud Car, Prototype Cloud Car, or sometimes as a single-pod cloud car.<ref name="PotF2" /> From a design perspective, the vehicle was considered to be a single pod from the [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod]] cloud car. However, it had a number of notable design differences. For instance, the Pod Car employed a more rounded [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] canopy design, and a much more angular chassis appearance.<ref name="TPoV">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Cloud City Pod Car}}</ref> One major difference was the Pod Car's extendable assault wings and [[S-foils/Legends|air foils]], deployed during attack mode. These extendable air foils revealed a nose-mounted launcher, capable of firing an [[Color/Legends|orange]] colored, wedge shaped [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]]. Combat equipped versions of the Cloud [[City/Legends|City]] Pod Car included mounted, dual [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on their underbellies. The Pod Car was orange in color, much like other cloud cars,<ref name="PotF2" /> and its interior was made with rich [[Corellian leather|Corellian]] [[Leather/Legends|leather]].<ref name="TPoV" /> As an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], the Pod Car was capable of flying at high altitudes.<ref name="PotF2" /> However, it was also capable of traveling low across the terrain, much like an ordinary [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].<ref name="SWG" /> The Pod Car, a prototype in design, was propelled by a single [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]], and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a single person.<ref name="PotF2" />

==History==
Manufactured by Bespin Motors,<ref name="PotF2" /> the Pod Car was popularized by its use in the habitable zone of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], home of Cloud City.<ref name="TPoV" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="SWG" /> the Pod Car served as an atmospheric patrol craft for the [[Cloud City Sky Patrol]].<ref name="PotF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
As a result of its growing popularity,<ref name="TPoV" /> the Cloud City Pod Car saw use on other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], used by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] as personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vehicles. These civilian-use Pod Cars lacked the mounted dual blaster cannons and proton torpedo launcher, but the assault wings and air foils could still be extended.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}
There also existed another type of [[Cloud City Pod Car|single-pod cloud car]] which was used as an atmospheric patrol craft on Bespin.<ref name="TESB:BAB">[[Star Wars (1977) 43|''Star Wars'' (1977) 43]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CloudCityPodCarToy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The back of the box for the Expanded Universe Cloud Car toy, released in 1998 as part of ''The Power of the Force 2'' toy line. One of the production sketches used for the making of the toy can be seen.]]
The Cloud City Pod Car was originally conceived of as concept art. Its first inclusion in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[canon]] was with the release of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] Cloud Car toy in the first quarter of [[1998]], as part of [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''The Power of the Force 2'']] toy line. The toy includes an Exclusive Cloud Car Pilot figure, and the box contains information on the cloud car's [[in-universe]] specifications. The toy is simply called a Cloud Car, however it is also identified as a Prototype Cloud Car, and Bespin Motors Cloud Car on the box's information card. The vehicle is described as having been affiliated with the Cloud City Sky Patrol. Some notable aspects of the toy are its extendable assault wings and air foils. The assault wings can be extended by the push of a button on the rear of the toy, while an orange proton torpedo can be launched from the toy's nose by pressing yet another button on the base of the toy (after extending the air foils manually). The description on the box claims that the single cockpit cloud car was designed and built based on production sketches found in [[The Art of Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back|''The Art of Star Wars'']], and that its brainchild was renowned ''Star Wars'' artist [[Ralph McQuarrie]]. The box has a depiction of one such production sketch.<ref name="PotF2" /> This appears to contradict the toy's entry in [[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive|''The Action Figure Archive'']], released on [[February 1]], [[1999]]. The book claims that the single-pod cloud car was based on a different sketch made by [[Joe Johnston]], while only the cloud car pilot was based on design work from McQuarrie.<ref name="TAFA">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>

[[File:CloudCItyPodCarConcept.png|thumb|left|250px|A concept sketch of the single-pod cloud car as depicted in ''The Action Figure Archive'']]
It was not until around twelve years later that the toy made its first official appearance in a [[LucasArts]] production. In ''[[The Price of Victory]]'' expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' released on [[December 14]], [[2010]], the cloud car, this time identified as a Cloud City Pod Car, was one of many loot cards that could be claimed by players of the [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="TPoV" /> Once claimed by the player, the Pod Car could be used as a [[:w:c:swg:Vehicle|vehicle]] similar to that of any other ground vehicle in the [[Star Wars video games|game]]. Unlike the toy, the Pod Car in ''Star Wars Galaxies'' did not have the mounted dual blaster cannons, and while it did appear to have the orange, wedge shaped torpedo, it could not be fired by the player.<ref name="SWG" /> Furthermore, despite its classification as an atmospheric repulsorcraft,<ref name="PotF2" /> the Pod Car in ''Galaxies'' could only travel low across the ground, due to limitations in game mechanics at the time.<ref name="SWG" /> The card description for the Cloud City Pod Car claimed that the vehicle was a single pod from the twin-pod cloud car, despite looking very different from any pod on the Storm IV.<ref name="TPoV" /> The vehicle was rendered unobtainable after the game, developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]], along with its accompanying Trading Card Game.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Although the player could choose not to claim and drive the Cloud City Pod Car (assuming he or she were to obtain the Trading Card Game card), this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" />
